name: Eli
summary: The priest at Shiloh who judged Israel forty years and raised the young Samuel. He did not restrain his wicked sons, and he died when he heard the ark of God was taken.

key_moments.title: He Thought Hannah Was Drunk
key_moments.description: Eli watched Hannah praying silently and thought she was drunk. When she told him she was pouring out her soul to the LORD, he sent her in peace and asked God to grant her request.

key_moments.title: His Wicked Sons
key_moments.description: Eli was very old and heard the evil his sons did, and he warned them, but they would not listen. A man of God told him both his sons would die on the same day.

key_moments.title: Teaching Samuel to Listen
key_moments.description: When Samuel kept running to him in the night, Eli understood the LORD was calling the boy and told him how to answer. The LORD spoke judgment on Eli's house, and Eli said the LORD should do what seemed good to Him.

key_moments.title: The News from the Battle
key_moments.description: At ninety-eight years old, Eli heard that his sons were dead and the ark of God was taken. He fell backward from his seat by the gate, broke his neck and died.
